Agent.description: Limits of the agent session. Which runner and model run it is configuration, never the contract's (ADR 0029).

tools.description: Read-only tools the agent may use, in the runner's naming (e.g. `Read`, `Grep`); empty for the runner's read-only default. The agent gets no hz tools: inputs are fetched before it starts.
tools.title: Tools

max_usd.description: Most one run may cost in US dollars; your `[workflow] max_usd` caps it whatever it says.
max_usd.title: Max Usd

Agent.title: Agent

Hz.description: Everything Heinzelmännchen reads from a contract, under one `hz:` key (ADR 0021).

title.description: Display name, shown in lists and the daemon's jobs.
title.title: Title

scope.description: Who runs it: `personal`, on your own daemon. Team scope comes with the state repository.
scope.title: Scope

schedule.description: When the daemon runs it: five cron fields in local time, e.g. `0 7 * * MON`. Without one it runs only with `hz workflow run`.
schedule.title: Schedule

requires.description: Capabilities it reads, `<capability>:read`, e.g. `tracker:read`; `agent-runner:read` is implied. Configuration decides which adapter serves each; a contract never pins one nor writes.
requires.title: Requires

inputs.description: Data fetched before the agent starts, by name; each needs its capability.
inputs.title: Inputs

outputs.description: What the agent drafts, by name: exactly one in this version.
outputs.title: Outputs

publishes.description: Where the draft is meant to go, through publish operations; recorded, never run automatically.
publishes.title: Publishes

timeout.description: How long the agent session may take.
timeout.title: Timeout

retries.description: Retries within a daemon tick after a failed run; the cost cap covers all attempts together.
retries.title: Retries

catch_up.description: Missed schedule slots: `latest` runs once for the newest, `skip` none.
catch_up.title: Catch Up

Hz.title: Hz

Input.description: Data fetched through a capability's read method before the agent session starts (ADR 0029, option a).

read.description: The capability read method that fetches it, `<capability>.<method>`, e.g. `tracker.issues_updated`; `hz system capability list` shows the capabilities.
read.title: Read

args.description: Arguments of the method besides its time window, e.g. `{project: APP}`.
args.title: Args

window.description: For methods that take a time window: how far back from the run, e.g. `7d`.
window.title: Window

Input.title: Input

Output.description: What the agent drafts; in 0.2 the draft is saved locally and nothing is published automatically.

format.description: What the agent writes: `markdown` (the default) or `json`.
format.title: Format

Output.title: Output

Publish.description: A write the draft is meant for, through a publish operation; recorded, never run automatically in 0.2.

action.description: The publish operation (`read_only=False`) that would write it, `<module>.<operation>`, e.g. `notes.publish`; it declares `write` itself, the contract never does (ADR 0028).
action.title: Action

output.description: The output it publishes, a key of `hz.outputs`.
output.title: Output

Publish.title: Publish

description: The YAML frontmatter of a contract: OpenProse-compatible identity on top, Heinzelmännchen's keys under `hz`.

name.description: The contract's name: lowercase words joined by dashes; equals the file stem.
name.title: Name

description.description: What the workflow keeps true, and for whom.
description.title: Description
